operations.details: Verified official OS Terrain 50 grid-data technical specification: ASCII supply is a raster grid; each height value is calculated from the centre of a 50m by 50m pixel.
Bound Terrain50 numeric interpretation to pixel-centre height semantics; polygon all_touched selection is kept distinct from a claim that every selected pixel centre lies inside the parcel.
Verified each 10km Terrain50 ASCII tile contains 200 rows by 200 columns at 50m cellsize.
Verified six-line ASCII header plus west-to-east data rows; line/token audit therefore uses 1-based file line = data_row_index + 7 and 1-based token = column_index + 1.
Verified OS Terrain 50 ASCII height values are supplied to the nearest 0.1m; no finer OS numeric precision may be invented.
Verified official OS Terrain 50 Known Data Issues page currently reports no live known data issues.
No-live-known-issue status is retained only as product QA context and is not promoted to proof that any parcel value is error-free.
Verified official OS product-supply guidance: Terrain50 ASCII/GML download is available without registration and is supplied in 10km-by-10km tiles.
Verified Terrain50 full-tile resupply is annual in July; current OpenData product page reports Version Date July 2026.
Verified HMLR technical guidance states INSPIRE polygon data is captured against British National Grid.
Verified HMLR warns BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection may shift some features by up to 15m; exact measurement remains native EPSG:27700.
Verified current EA LIDAR Composite DTM 1m metadata reports EPSG:27700 and +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
Verified the current EA DTM1m dataset exposes a WCS service; WCS availability remains the primary current numeric-source contract.
TQ39 line19/token111 cell intersects exact Enfield polygon by 31.699 m2; pixel centre 535525,199375 is not treated as a parcel-inside point claim.
TQ39 line19/token112 cell intersects exact Enfield polygon by 176.050 m2; the two intersections sum to the 207.748 m2 polygon area at 0.001 m2 rounding.
TQ59 line195/token40 cell intersects exact Havering polygon by 18.083 m2; all_touched inclusion is intersection-based.
TQ59 line196/token40 cell intersects exact Havering polygon by 420.996 m2.
TQ59 line196/token41 cell intersects exact Havering polygon by 20.840 m2; three intersections sum to 459.919 m2 at 0.001 m2 rounding.
TQ27 line204/token190 cell intersects exact Lambeth polygon by 364.587 m2.
TQ27 line204/token191 cell intersects exact Lambeth polygon by 75.847 m2; two intersections sum to 440.433 m2 at 0.001 m2 rounding.
For all three exact polygons, the union-partition of selected 50m cells conserves polygon area to 0.001 m2 rounding; no intersecting grid cell is omitted or duplicated.

Closed the raster-semantics QA gap: selected Terrain50 cells are polygon-intersecting raster pixels, while OS height values are defined at pixel centres; these concepts are explicitly separated before future numeric crosscheck.
Preserved EA height differences remain 0.270m, 0.831m and 0.490m at 96% confidence; no Terrain50 elevation value or EA-to-OS numeric crosscheck is claimed without current TQ bytes.
Publisher-safe child staging only; no canonical manifest mutation, second task/runner, business-row promotion, fake data or final_ready claim.
